requests: Coordinate case rim and frame colors, provide multiple starting themes, preserve selections, and export actual printable parts and joining details.
Improve commercial component shape, nominal dimensions and appearance, especially nice!nano v2.
status: Published digital update; anonymous implementation archive, Pages, browser interactions and downloaded print kits verified. Bambu palette interoperability and physical assembly remain partial.

dispositions.colors: Explicit per-half colors, color-only presets, optional bidirectional rim/frame link; preserve old configurations.
dispositions.printing: Unchanged native STL bytes, selected installed parts, supports including washers, actual screw/magnet interfaces; no clips claimed. Generic color 3MF is experimental; Bambu automatic palette import remains unaccepted.
dispositions.components: Own nominal nano/view reconstruction; official vs community dimensions and visual inference distinguished. KiSwitch/KiCad sources pinned per file. No reflected commercial modules.
dispositions.support: Scalloped upper shelves clear sockets and underside pad reserves; positive support area must be checked.
dispositions.connector_gap: The 7 versus 8.8 mm display connector gap remains open, without visually stretching pins.
dispositions.physical: No hardware/manufacturing acceptance inferred from rendering or digital checks.

secret_scan.scope: Attributable staged source and generated viewer

rebuild_regression.scope: Bounding-box and parameter regression only; full nominal solid checks are separate.

evidence.full_source_rebuild: Native assembly regenerated from source; component, parameter/save-reopen, finishes, cases, rim and service checks all passed for the new source digest.

retrospective.trigger: Actual component geometry exposed support and power-switch registration errors hidden by the earlier boxes.
retrospective.cause: The old board width left only 0.09 mm nominal support after correction; initial switch placement used an estimated center and wrong handed rotation instead of the existing footprint datum.
retrospective.correction: Scalloped ledges clear all 26 underside pad reserves; PCM12 centers match the current footprints, rotated +90/-90 degrees. Derived USB-to-battery clearance now uses actual bounds (1.9 mm), replacing the old 1.6 mm USB depth assumption.
retrospective.prevention: Keep local commercial geometry separate from half placement, compare unchanged source meshes and exact handedness, and check actual native intersection/support area before publication.
retrospective.validation: Both halves have zero unallowed native solid intersections; each nano has 30.815 mm2 nominal support and zero pad-reserve overlap. Physical solder, socket engagement and retention remain unqualified.

downstream_correction.trigger: Closure readback found the existing KiCad STEP references still contained old simplified boxes; color inspection also found the power/reset library materials were lost in the geometry-only importer.
downstream_correction.correction: Export the current nominal solids at each unchanged footprint datum; use ImportGui to preserve source face materials in the native assembly and all derived representations.
downstream_correction.prevention: Reimport every relative STEP, compare constituent solids and colored surface areas, reconstruct at actual footprint poses, and assert PCB hashes remain unchanged. Native checks reject missing switch palettes.
downstream_correction.scope: Component appearance and relative models only; no change to PCB footprints, routing or manufacturing qualification.
downstream_correction.rebuild_fix: Full source regeneration exposed a FreeCAD color assignment type mismatch; decoded JSON colors are now converted to tuples before applying DiffuseColor. Validation regenerates the native assembly from source.

artifact_disposition.committed: Source, pinned licensed component assets, generated reference CAD, screenshots, public documentation and validation receipts.
artifact_disposition.reproducible_ignored: build/ and viewer/node_modules/; regenerate with docs/cad.md and its exact checks. Downloads come from viewer/customize-check.cjs; STL/3MF identity is checked by tools/check_print_kit.py.
artifact_disposition.original_reviews: Original Spanish advisory reports and runtime receipts preserved in the local objective archive; public files are explicitly labeled English summaries.

validation_boundary.digital: Configured colors, selected mesh geometry, native support and source identity have dedicated tests. Final source hashes and public readback gate publication acceptance.
not_accepted: Automatic Bambu palette mapping and GUI save/reopen
Exact connector contacts and supplied socket/pouch details
Display connector 7 mm versus modeled PCB gap 8.8 mm
Physical fit, retained hardware, routed PCB, firmware and operation
validation_boundary.bambu_gui: GUI palette import/save/reopen remains unverified; explicit manual filament mapping is required.
